provenance: Original Knights Reforged alpha content and reconstructed balance. Kingdoms Live inspired the resource roles, repeatable equipment-gated quests, automatic one-item-per-category army use, and compact interface. No original server formulas are claimed.

maintenance.policy: Purchases never require passive income. All owned upkeep copies accrue proportionally to server time while maintained. Reserve and carried gold fund charges after due Land income. A funding shortfall pauses upkeep gear, caps arrears at one hourly bill, and stops further charges. Zero-upkeep gear remains usable. Resume pays arrears and funds one hourly reserve. No forced sales or compounding debt.
